run_conda_reader: run the conda reader script to test deserialization of cmake-written Faiss index files from a directory
test_backward_compatibility: test that conda-built Faiss can load and search index files written by cmake without crashing
validate_index_io: validate all index types written by cmake can be loaded by the conda reader
run_read_test_all_files: run read_test_all_files with reader conda and writer cmake on an input directory
check_io_compatibility: check backward compatibility between cmake-written and conda-read Faiss index files
